 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from the pressure tight 
 cover. If it found retighten the cover nut.
Check any internal leakage.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage.

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two 
 end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Screw off the nuts (24) of gland bolts (22).
Take up gland follower (12).
Dismantle the sleeve (11) with glands bolt.
Screw off nut (18).
Take up plate (17) by using two withdraws.

Take out the dividing ring (16) and take up 
 the ring (15).

Turn the valve hand to open it then the end of 
 spindle (8) pressed on the bottom of pressure tight cover (5) and take it up.

Screw off the nuts (23) and bolts (21), which 
 connected yoke (9) with nipple (2).

Take out the yoke (9) with spindle (8) with 
 wedge (7) with all parts above.
Take out the wedge (7) from spindle (8).

Turn the hand until the spindle goes out from 
 spindle nut (10).

Take out the gland follower (12) from spindle 
 (8).

Withdraw the spindle (8) from pressure tight 
 cover (5).

Take out the sealing (27) and gland sealing 
 (28) from pressure tight cover (5).

Screw off nut (30) and take out the valve hand 
 wheel (29).

Screw off bearing nut (19) and take out the 
 spindle nut (10) from yoke bearing house with upper bearing (26) by using 
 polyamide hammer.

Take out the lower bearing (26) from yoke 
 bearing house.

sections.text: Inspection and Repair of all parts

items:
Check the valve wedge (7) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valve seat (saddle) (4) and regrind 
 it if needed. When grinding the seats of the movers, attention must be paid to 
 maintaining the angles of the sealing surfaces. In order to secure the mover 
 function it is not allowed to reduce the seat parts by more than 0.8 mm in 
 total (not more than 0.4 mm for one surface).

Repair the valve wedge (7) and valve seats (4) 
 in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there.

Check the spindle (8) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.

Check the spindle nut (10) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.

Check the bearing (26) and replace it if 
 needed.

Check the dust seal rings (20) and replace them 
 if needed.

Check the bush (14) and repair it if needed or 
 replace it.

Check the body (1), nipple (25) from any cracks 
 or wear by using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable 
 filler material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
If the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1
Clean every part well before any assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence 
 of disassembly.

sections.text: Replace the Packing of Valve Gland

items:
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with 
 the cut turned 180 , starting at 9 clock.
Tight the gland bolts.

Open and close the valve and be sure that the 
 valve operation is correct.

valve to check that every thing is OK.

Introduction
This
 document out outlines the minor maintenance procedure as indicated by P1 in 
 the above title block 
 for the manual gate valve depending on external / internal leakage
This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (Open / closed only 
 state)
The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 27 Dec 2003, accepted by General Director 
eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng.. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of Talkha power station.
